title: Non-anchor position period prediction v10
rationale: This lane predeclares a position-period residue rule before scoring any new observations. It does not use public anchor-derived additive fragments, candidate words, routed key-material scores, or prior public-fragment controls as discovery evidence, so it is not another public-anchor mining pass.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in one or more predeclared residue classes from the registered period set before any candidate-word, route, or public-anchor-derived fragment scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: Registered period set fixed before evaluation: 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 13
Deterministic residue-class rule emitted before observing new source-backed positions
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations
A committed held-out non-anchor position set not derived from public known-plaintext clue alignments
controls: multiple-comparison correction across the registered period set
